item.title: [VCB-Studio] 魔王2099 / Demon Lord 2099 10-bit 1080p HEVC BDRip [Fin]
item.description:
魔王2099 / Demon Lord 2099 BDRip

原盘画质中等偏下。线条锐度较高，带有较强的振铃；色度平面存在色度锯齿，在多数红色场景明显可见；部分暗场有可见色带。
The source exhibits subpar image quality, characterized by sharp lines, significant ringing, aliasing in chroma planes (prominent in red scenes), and visible banding in partial dark scenes.

我们对线条使用了较强的去振铃和较弱的抗锯齿处理，并进行了较弱的补偿性锐化来提升观感；对平面则进行了去色带处理和自适应降噪，并对色度平面进行了重构。
Strong de-ringing and mild anti-aliasing were applied to the lines, complemented by mild compensatory sharpening to enhance visual performance. For flat areas, de-banding, adaptive denoising, and chroma plane reconstruction were performed.

Most scenes have a native resolution of 900. The lines vary between blurry and sharp, with obvious aliasing. The noise in flat areas looks rather poor, but dither was added, so there is hardly any banding. The ED appears to have been produced separately, with noticeably better quality and a resolution close to FHD. The processing consists of the usual few steps, so I won't go into further detail.
